summary: Backend-only verification of the analytics engine + clinician/data-driven coach layer. All 50 tests green: iter83_analytics_and_coach 15/15, test_training_analytics 22/22, test_ai_coach_context_upgrade 13/13. Verified every scenario in the request: GET /api/analytics for creep/e1rm/injury/thin/empty users (RPE 7→7.5→8.5→9 @185 Bench flagged; effective bench=324 vs entered=300 diverges; rising shoulder pain trend with 4 OHP correlations; low-confidence for thin user; empty user 200 with no analytics doc). Coach chat cited actual seeded numbers: 'Should I deload?' for creep cited RPE 7, RPE 9, and 185 lbs and advised deload; e1rm user got has_program_change:true with type='load_update', payload referenced bench 300→324, response language PROPOSED (not applied) and CRITICAL: db.profile.basePRs.bench remained 300 after chat (NO-AUTO-APPLY guarantee confirmed at the mongo layer); injury user response cited Overhead Press and advised modification; thin user reply explicitly noted 'only 2 weeks of logs'; empty user chat returned 200 with valid conversation_id and non-empty response (analytics absence never broke chat). Background refresh confirmed: POST /api/log as analytics_empty created a db.training_analytics doc with logCount>=1 within ~10s and it is visible via GET /api/analytics. Staleness recompute confirmed: backdating computedAt by 30h caused GET /api/analytics to produce a strictly-newer computedAt. GET /api/analytics/block-recommendations for e1rm returned available:true, startLoads.bench.source='effective', basis1RM≈324, volumeModifier in [0.8, 1.1], rationale non-empty (list form accepted). Regressions clean: coach ADD_EXERCISE 'Add 3x10 face pulls to today' returned added_exercise.name containing 'face'; POST /api/log completed in <5s (background hook non-blocking). Deprecated packages still detected: expo-av (frontend, pre-existing; not in scope for this backend-only task).
action_items: Nothing blocking. The AI-coach analytics/clinician layer is verified end-to-end: TRENDS-block signals surface in coach replies with actual numbers, PROGRAM_CHANGE proposals never auto-apply (mongo state confirmed unchanged), background refresh + 24h staleness recompute both work, and analytics absence does not break chat.

(Nice-to-have, not required now) GET /api/analytics/block-recommendations returns 'rationale' as a list (not a string). Test accepts both shapes — but please pick one shape and document it before this endpoint is wired into plan generation later.
critical_code_review_comments: NO-AUTO-APPLY guarantee verified at the mongo layer (not just via UI wording): after the e1rm user's load_update proposal, db.profile.basePRs.bench remained 300 (never rewritten to ~324). This is the correct behavior — proposals require explicit user confirmation.

Effective-1RM never overwrites the entered basePR — verified both at the unit level (test_effective_1rm_never_overwrites_entered) and via the block-recommendations endpoint (startLoads.bench.source='effective' with basis1RM≈324 while entered stays 300).

Background refresh hook in POST /api/log is properly async — /api/log returned in <5s (typically <1s) and the training_analytics doc materialized within ~1-2 poll cycles. No slowdown on the log write path from the bg task hook.

Analytics failure never breaks chat: the empty user (no logs, no training_analytics doc) got a normal 200 response with conversation_id — TRENDS block appears to be built defensively (build_trends_context returns '' for None/{}, verified in unit tests).
24h staleness recompute is idempotent and monotonic — backdating by 30h produced a strictly-newer computedAt on the next GET.

Coach replies cite the actual seeded numbers (RPE 7, RPE 9, 185 lbs for creep user; Overhead Press for injury user; bench 300→~324 for e1rm user) — the DATA-DRIVEN ADVISING prompt block is threading through to Claude correctly.
seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/seed_analytics_test_users.py (idempotent). Test also created one additional bench log for analytics_empty@test.com (per request note, this is expected/fine).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter83_analytics_and_coach.py covers: analytics per-scenario, block-recommendations, coach data-driven advising with numeric-citation asserts, no-auto-apply mongo probe, background refresh, staleness recompute, ADD_EXERCISE regression, /api/log latency. Coach reply asserts are keyword-based (order-insensitive) to survive Claude non-determinism. If block-recommendations 'rationale' shape changes to always-string, remove the list branch. rca_of_issue: No bugs found — all scenarios in the review request passed. Two initial false-alarm test failures during iter83 authoring were resolved as test-script issues (my assertions were too narrow): (1) 'rationale' is returned as a list on this endpoint, so I now accept list-or-string; (2) the thin-user disclaimer used '2 weeks of logs' / 'baseline is thin' phrasing which my initial keyword list didn't cover — added those phrases. Both fixes were test-side only; no production code was modified.
